description: Delivers a message to Andrey Zubar through the same mechanism as the contact form on the home page. Requires the human user's approval of the exact text and reply-to e-mail (confirmed_by_user=true). Rate limited; duplicates are not sent twice. / Отправить сообщение владельцу как через форму на главной; только с согласия пользователя.

confirmed_by_user.description: Must be true: the human user reviewed and approved this exact text and email.

email.description: Where the owner should reply. Must belong to the human user who approved the message.

message.description: The request: what is needed, context, budget or deadlines if known. Plain text, up to 3 links.

request_id.description: Optional lowercase UUID to make retries idempotent.

name: send_message
title: Send a message to the owner
